FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Daily Cadence Update
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Updates the mod to match the new daily production cadence in the base Empire Refactored mod.

patchNoteLines.li: Numerous changes to make stockpiling work on a daily cadence. Routes (complex mode) still work on a tax-cycle cadence.

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Daily Cadence Fixes
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Fixes a few issues lingering after the Daily Cadence update.

patchNoteLines.li: Separate daily calculations (production, needs, stockpiling) from tax cycle-level calculations (routes, sell orders) in the UI
Bugfix: rounding issues could create situations where a seemingly maxed-out production allocation slider produced constant clicking noises

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Supply Route Changes
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: A handful of changes to supply routes (only relevant for Complex mode).

patchNoteLines.li: The player can now control how frequently routes are sent out
Routes now take time to reach their destination, based on the distance and path from the source

Adds an optional caravan-based route system. When enabled (default off), deliveries are represented by actual world objects that traverse the world map. This can be performance intensive (hence defaulting to off)
Replace the "grace period" mechanic with granting all settlements a small amount of food, logging, and mining stockpile when founded
Update the mod settings for clearer separation, and to let the player tune the on-founding stockpile amounts
Allow routes to be edited after creation

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Minor Updates
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: A couple of minor backend & frontend updates.

patchNoteLines.li: Rewrite the stat modifier description for sell rate multiplier, route efficiency bonus, and tax efficiency so that they read the same as every other stat modifier in the UI
Update the Overflow Silver tooltips to handle fractional amounts
Bugfix: route deliveries that hit after loading the game but before a tax cycle would disappear into the void

Bugfix: in Simple mode, on founding a new settlement, stockpile caps wouldn't be recalculated until after the new-settlement starting resources are granted, meaning that some of those starting resources could be lost to the abyss
Bugfix: events with a 'convert to silver' option wouldn't actually convert the goods to silver
Bugfix: when switching from simple to complex mode, the distributed resources could overflow a settlement's stockpile cap and be silently lost
Bugfix: the settlement cost shown in the new settlement screen could deviate from the settlement cost the game uses to check if the player can afford it
Bugfix: in simple mode, an event with a stockpile-based multiplier could end up stacking that multiplier against the faction stockpile a number of times equal to the number of settlements involved
Bugfix: incomplete translation string for Tithe Injection Description

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Warhouse Chain Building Art
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Adds new art for the warhouse building chain, courtesy of Midnight.

patchNoteLines.li: New art for Storehouse, Warehouse, Warehouse Complex, and Logistics Hub

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Updated Placeholder Art
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Added new building placeholder art to make it easier to tell the buildings apart.

patchNoteLines.li: New placeholder art for Armory, Arsenal, Cold Storage, Distribution Center, Power Reserve, and Power Vault

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Settings Update
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Adds the mod version to the mod settings.

patchNoteLines.li: Add the mod version to the settings
Bugfix: if the founding cost multiplier is set to 0, then founding can sometimes still be rejected
